title: Pg Basebackup And Point In Time Recovery
summary: PITR combines a base backup with archived WAL so recovery can replay to a timestamp, LSN, or named target. archive_command must be monitored as production infrastructure, and retention must cover both recovery goals and the time needed to discover an incident.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Pg Basebackup And Point In Time Recovery.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
